PluginData.Author: TomasServo
PluginData.Tooltip: Streams atomic.fm from Icecast into the Space Engineers client.
PluginData.Description:
All Ultralounge all the time.
atomic.fm brings live internet radio, music, and ambient station audio to Space Engineers through Pulsar. Tune into the default Icecast stream at http://radio.atomic.fm:8000/atomic-radio, or turn almost any terminal block into a spatial radio source by adding atomic.fm=true to Custom Data.
Use it for lounges, bars, ships, stations, hangars, stores, events, faction bases, and server communities that want music without adding a server mod. Optional per-block settings include atomic.fm.range=35 and atomic.fm.volume=5.5 on a 0-11 scale. Ctrl+Alt+M toggles playback manually. Audio is client-side; the default stream uses plain HTTP and exposes listener IPs to the author-operated station server.
